journey: A reader opens three.ws/forge-max, finds the High tier already selected, types what they want, and gets back a 200k-poly model with 4K PBR textures from the engine that suits the subject. High is a $THREE holder perk, so the generation itself needs a holder session.

steps.name: three.ws/forge-max opens the Forge with the High tier pinned (the Generate button reads the High gate before the reader touches anything)

steps.expect: 200k-poly geometry, 4K PBR textures, subject-aware engine routing

steps.name: the live Forge catalog defines the High tier as a 200,000-poly PBR tier
the live Forge catalog marks the High tier as PBR textured
the router's tests prove High-tier engine choice follows the subject (hard-surface to TRELLIS, organic to Hunyuan3D)
a High generation without a $THREE holder session is refused with the hold-or-pay gate, so this trial cannot run the High generation itself
